_comment: Full materiality/climate-risk persistence — expanded from the Phase 11 minimal scope (data-quality exceptions 8 and 9) to full parity with apps/web's materiality.ts/climate-risk.ts as part of the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration. Scoring logic stays in functions/shared/pure/materiality-scoring.ts and climate-risk.ts; these tables now hold every field that logic reads/writes, not just the data-quality-check subset. MaterialTopics/MaterialityConsultations already matched apps/web's schema field-for-field; ClimateRisks did not (see its own comment below) and was completed during the apps/web Phase C reports/materiality/climate-risk slice.

tables.comment: One row per topic per property per reporting period. GRI (impact/double materiality) and IFRS S1 (financial/single materiality) are scored independently in the same row — see classifyMateriality() in the ported pure logic, which combines the two only into a label, never a blended number.

columns.comment: Null = group-wide topic.
This is the general 'impact materiality score' — was previously named gri_impact_materiality_score.
Null triggers the 'materiality topic missing financial score' data-quality exception.

tables.comment: Repeatable stakeholder/expert consultation records — GRI 3 requires these be documented, not just a checkbox. Ported from apps/web materiality_consultations.

IFRS S2 climate-related H&S risks ONLY — heat stress, extreme-weather exposure, wildfire smoke, etc. Never ordinary incidents. hazard_type/likelihood_score/impact_score/residual_risk_score are the original Phase 11 minimal-scope columns (kept as-is — other Functions already read them); every other column below was added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration to reach actual full parity with apps/web's climate-risk.ts (category, description, exposure/vulnerability/existing_controls narrative fields, time_horizon, financial_effect, currency, adaptation_action, responsible_owner, scenario_assumptions, resilience_conclusion, status/assessed_by/approved_by/approved_at, created_at/updated_at were all missing from the original port despite the file header's earlier claim of full parity).

columns.comment: One of the climate_hazard values (climateHazardEnum) — the specific hazard, e.g. 'cyclone', 'heat_stress'.
Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — missing from the original port. Must agree with hazard_type per categoryForHazard() in the ported climate-risk.ts pure logic.
